meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 当用户要求审查已完成的工作时,Claude 会并行启动 5 个后台子代理,分别检查目标达成、代码质量、安全、实际运行效果、上下文遗漏。所有检查全部通过才算审核通过,并输出各代理的审查结论与最终判定。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求审查已完成的工作(例如说「审查我的工作」「检查更改」等),或准备提交 PR 前需要审核时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude launches 5 parallel background sub-agents to review completed work: goal/constraint verification, code quality, security, hands-on QA execution, and context mining. All must pass for the review to pass. It outputs each agent's verdict and the final pass/fail result.
howto.when_en: Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work ('review my work', 'check my changes', etc.).

say_en.note: Runs the app and checks behavior.

say_en.text: Verify this implementation meets the requirements
say_en.note: Focuses on goal achievement and constraints.
